title: Luscious Canadian Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole featuring lamb leg, perfect for a crowd, this dish is also Buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any forbidden ingredients. It is a fatty and pillowy delight that is sure to please.

ingredients.name: lamb leg
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the melted butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the lamb cubes to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots and potato to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and chicken broth until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with dried thyme.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
